<bole-experience>
Use this experience only when applicable: Use only when the task explicitly requires starting a server, hosting a local index, or leaving an API service running for later clients.
For a service needed after the agent finishes, a tool background-job ID, plain `command &`, and PPID 1 alone do not prove persistence. Use a service supervisor if present; otherwise launch the foreground server executable in a separate session with all standard streams detached. Capture the launching shell's session ID, then from a fresh command check that the server is listening and its session ID differs from the launch shell's. If a detached launch fails, inspect its log and repair the launch; never fall back to a plain background job while claiming the service is durable. Finally exercise the exact client request and leave the verified listener running.
</bole-experience>
